init.title: Attendance reporting and quotas
init.description:
Enter your normal quota and its period. For example, 37.5 hours per 1 week, a quota per 10 days, per 2 weeks or per 6 months. Weekly anchors must be Mondays; monthly anchors must be the first day of a month.

Rollups distribute the quota across normal workdays and compute other period targets. Holiday adjustment removes holiday allocations without increasing other days. Both are optional.

data.quota_rollups: Convert quota into other reporting periods

holidays.title: Holiday calendar
holidays.description: Choose a country for locally calculated public holidays, or use custom dates only. Observed holidays are included.

calendar.title: Holiday region and additional dates
calendar.description: Choose a subdivision where applicable. Additional dates use YYYY-MM-DD, one per line. These dates reduce the quota only when holiday adjustment is enabled.

error.invalid_reporting_options: Check quota hours, period length, anchor date, workdays and holiday dates. Periods are limited to 366 days, 52 weeks or 12 months.
